Mariam's Collection

Modest fashion · US & UK · mariam-col.com

Fashion Religion & Spirituality Wellness & Lifestyle

Mariam's Collection is a modest fashion brand created for Muslim women living and thriving in the West. We design abayas and hijabs that are elegant, intentional, and authentically you — pieces that honour your faith without compromising on style.

Our community spans the UK, US, Canada, Australia and beyond. We work with ambassadors who genuinely share our values and want to introduce modest fashion to the women in their world. No minimum follower count required — we believe in authentic recommendation over reach.

As an affiliate, you earn 10% commission on every confirmed sale, with a 30-day cookie window, real-time dashboard tracking, and monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer. We also provide ready-to-use product images, video content, and caption templates to make promotion as easy as possible.

What we offer our affiliates

Ready-to-use product photos, video clips and caption templates

Real-time dashboard — track clicks, orders and earnings live

Gifted products and exclusive discount codes for active ambassadors

Open to all — no minimum follower count, any platform welcome

Payment schedule: Commissions are paid around the 15th of each month via PayPal (min. $50) or bank transfer (min. $100). Balances below the threshold roll over to the following month.

Ambassador Program Terms & Conditions

Mariam's Collection — Version 2.2 | June 2026

Full Affiliate Policy — v2.2

Complete program terms, enforcement, appeals, and all 12 sections


Welcome to the Mariam's Collection Ambassador Program.

By registering, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these terms in full.


─────────────────────────────────


1. Application & Approval


We reserve the right to approve or decline any application at our sole discretion. Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance. We may request additional information about your promotion channels before approving your account.


─────────────────────────────────


2. Two Programs — Know Which One You Join


We operate two affiliate programs. Your account will be assigned to the program that matches how you promote.


Content Creator Program

Commission: 10% | Cookie window: 30 days

For: Social media creators, bloggers, YouTubers, newsletter writers, podcasters, and affiliates boosting their own content posts on Meta, TikTok, or Pinterest.

Approval required: No — start immediately.


Paid & Deal Program

Commission: 5% | Cookie window: 7 days

For: Affiliates running non-brand keyword paid search ads (Google, Meta) or official independent coupon and cashback platforms.

Approval required: Yes — email Affiliate@mariam-col.com before going live.


If you are unsure which program applies to you, email us before promoting. Starting in the wrong program is not a violation — we will move you to the correct one.


─────────────────────────────────


3. Affiliate Links, Codes & Attribution


Upon approval, you will receive a unique tracking link and/or personal discount code.


- Attribution uses last-click logic. Where both a discount code and a tracking link are present on the same order, discount code attribution takes priority.

- Your personal affiliate code may be shared on your own channels.

- Public promotional codes (e.g. EID10, SUMMER20) may be shared freely.

- Internal dynamic codes (including DCW-series abandoned cart and VIP win-back codes) are private customer codes. You must never share, distribute, or use these codes. If you encounter one, contact Affiliate@mariam-col.com immediately. Distributing internal dynamic codes is a serious violation and bypasses the standard warning process.

- Our checkout uses anti-leak discount technology to protect your affiliate attribution at checkout.


─────────────────────────────────


4. Commissions, Tiers & Payment


Commission is calculated on product value only, excluding shipping and taxes. Orders that are refunded, cancelled, or charged back are not commissionable.


Content Creator Performance Tiers (confirmed orders required):


Starter     | 0–4 orders/month          | —              | 10%

Rising      | 5+ orders/month           | 2 months       | 10% + priority support

Ambassador  | 15+ orders/month          | 2 months       | 12% + gifted products

Elite       | 30+ orders/month          | 3 months       | 15% + exclusive products + co-creation


Tier upgrades require consecutive months of performance — not a single strong month. Calculations are based on confirmed, non-reversed orders only. Paid & Deal affiliates earn a flat 5% regardless of volume.


Gifted products are available from Ambassador level upward. Eligibility requires 15+ confirmed orders/month for 2 consecutive months.


Payout schedule:

- Commissions are processed on the 15th of every month for the prior month's confirmed orders.

- Minimum payout: PayPal — $50 USD. Wise — $100 USD.

- Earnings below the minimum threshold roll over to the following month.

- Payment details must be saved under Settings → Payments. Accounts without payment details will have earnings held until details are added.


─────────────────────────────────


5. Paid Advertising Policy


Paid promotion is permitted within the following limits.


ALLOWED without approval:

- Boosting your own content posts on Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or Facebook

- TikTok Spark Ads on your own content

- All organic and SEO content on any public platform


REQUIRES prior written approval (Paid & Deal program):

- Non-brand keyword search ads on Google or Meta (e.g. "modest abaya UK", "hijab dress")

- Listings on official independent coupon or cashback platforms


NOT ALLOWED:

- Google Shopping ads pointing directly to our store

- Any paid promotion that routes traffic directly to our store without going through your own content


PERMANENT VIOLATION — results in immediate termination:

- Bidding on brand keywords: "Mariam", "Mariam's Collection", mariam-col.com, or any variation thereof, on any advertising platform, under any circumstances


To request approval for paid search campaigns, email Affiliate@mariam-col.com with your platform, target keywords, ad copy, and conversion tracking method. We respond within 48 hours. Campaigns run before receiving written approval are not eligible for commission.


─────────────────────────────────


6. Channel Classification & Reclassification


Your program assignment is based on your primary promotion channel — the channel responsible for 60% or more of your referred orders in the past 30 days.


We review program assignments monthly. If your primary channel changes significantly, we will notify you and give you 7 days to respond before any reclassification takes effect. Reclassification is a correction, not a penalty. Commission rates are not adjusted retroactively for good-faith reclassifications.


─────────────────────────────────


7. SEO, Content Sites & Domain Policy


You may publish honest, original content about Mariam's Collection on any public platform — including blog posts, YouTube reviews, social content, and comparison articles. This is fully supported.


You may NOT:

- Register any domain name containing "Mariam", "mariam-col", or any confusingly similar variation (including misspellings and hyphenated forms)

- Build a standalone website or landing page whose primary purpose is to rank for our brand name and redirect traffic to your affiliate link


─────────────────────────────────


8. Coupon & Deal Platform Policy


Official independent coupon and cashback platforms (e.g. Honey, TopCashback, RetailMeNot) may participate under the Paid & Deal program with prior written approval.


Individual affiliates must not post links or codes on third-party coupon or aggregator sites without prior written approval. If we detect your link on an unapproved aggregator site, your commission on those orders will be adjusted to 5% retroactively and you will be notified. Repeated violations escalate to account suspension.


Self-built discount or review sites are not eligible for either program and are treated as unapproved third-party distribution.


─────────────────────────────────


9. Disclosure Requirements


You must disclose your affiliate relationship on all content where you promote Mariam's Collection. Use #ad, #sponsored, or #affiliate clearly in posts, videos, and descriptions.


This is a legal requirement under the UK ASA, US FTC, and EU regulations. Failure to disclose is a program violation.


─────────────────────────────────


10. Prohibited Activities


The following are prohibited regardless of program or channel:


- Self-referral: Using your own affiliate link to place orders for yourself, family members, or associates

- Multiple accounts: Operating more than one affiliate account under different identities representing the same individual

- Cookie stuffing: Artificially placing tracking cookies without genuine user engagement (e.g. hidden iframes, auto-redirects)

- Fake traffic: Generating clicks, orders, or engagement through bots, click farms, or non-genuine means

- False or misleading claims: Making exaggerated or false statements about our products, or publishing fabricated reviews

- Traffic hijacking: Using tactics designed to intercept traffic from our paid ads, email flows, or other affiliate channels

- Internal dynamic code distribution: Sharing DCW-series or other private customer codes on any external platform


─────────────────────────────────


11. Enforcement & Appeals


We apply a graduated enforcement approach.


Warning: First-time unintentional violations — written notice + retroactive commission adjustment to 5% on affected orders.


Suspension (30 days): Second violation of the same rule, or first violation of the paid advertising or dynamic code policy — account suspended, commissions held, re-approval required to reinstate.


Permanent Termination: Brand keyword bidding, self-referral, cookie stuffing, fake traffic, multiple accounts, internal code distribution, or any deliberate fraud — immediate permanent ban, all pending commissions forfeited, all linked accounts terminated simultaneously.


Appeals: You have 7 days from the date of notification to submit an appeal to Affiliate@mariam-col.com. Include screenshots of promotional content, traffic source explanation, and code usage records. We issue a final decision within 5 business days. There is no right of appeal for terminations resulting from brand keyword bidding, cookie stuffing, or deliberate fraud.


We conduct periodic audits of conversion attribution. Where deliberate fraud is identified historically, commissions including previously paid amounts may be subject to clawback where permitted by applicable law.


─────────────────────────────────


12. Account Activity & Program Review


We conduct quarterly reviews of all affiliate accounts.


- Accounts with zero conversions in 90 days will receive a reactivation email. No response within 14 days results in account deactivation. You may reapply at any time.

- Accounts showing abnormal traffic patterns or concentrated conversion sources inconsistent with their program assignment will be flagged for manual review.

- Quarterly reviews affect flagged accounts only. All other accounts continue earning and progressing through tiers without interruption.


─────────────────────────────────


13. Cookie Tracking


We use cookies to track referrals. If a customer disables or clears cookies before completing a purchase, we are unable to track their activity and no commission will be payable for those visits. Our checkout uses anti-leak discount technology to help protect your attribution where possible.


─────────────────────────────────


14. Brand Guidelines


When representing Mariam's Collection, you agree to:

- Maintain a respectful, modest, and values-aligned tone consistent with our brand

- Not make false, exaggerated, or misleading claims about our products

- Not use our logo or imagery in ways that could damage our brand reputation

- Not publish fabricated reviews or fake testimonials


─────────────────────────────────


15. Marketing Assets


Brand assets (product images, lookbooks, caption templates, story templates) are available under Marketing Tools in your dashboard. These may only be used to promote Mariam's Collection through approved channels.


─────────────────────────────────


16. Program Termination


We reserve the right to terminate any ambassador account at any time for violation of these terms, fraudulent activity, or conduct inconsistent with our brand values. See Section 11 for the full enforcement process.


To voluntarily leave the program, email Affiliate@mariam-col.com.


─────────────────────────────────


17. Modifications to Terms


We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated to active affiliates with reasonable notice. Continued participation in the program following notification constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.


─────────────────────────────────


Full program policy, commission quick guide, and all supporting documents are available under Marketing Tools → Program Guide in your dashboard.


Questions? Email Affiliate@mariam-col.com

We read every message and reply within 24 hours.


Last updated: June 2026
